# The Canyon Cairns

*The Tolmach mark the canyon road with cairns, and Ennek wants three of them checked. Hunt 30 Dust Boggles while you are down there.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) |
| Level | 15 |
| Leads to | [Sure Footing](../quests/ennek_sure_footing.md) |

## Objectives

- Look at the upper cairn in [The Canyon Road](../maps/canyon_road.md)
- Look at the middle cairn in [The Canyon Road](../maps/canyon_road.md)
- Look at the lower cairn in [The Canyon Road](../maps/canyon_road.md)
- Defeat 30 [Dust Boggle](../monsters/dust_boggle.md) in [The Canyon Road](../maps/canyon_road.md)

## Rewards

- 1,600 EXP
- 300 mesos
- [Goat's Milk](../items/goats_milk.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md)
